title: Contiguous sublist check
prompt: Specification: Return True if and only if s appears as a contiguous sublist of l. An empty s is a sublist of every list, and a sublist longer than l cannot match. The function below is intended to satisfy this specification. Does it contain a bug? If yes, give the line number of the faulty statement (1-based, counting the `def` line as line 1). If the bug spans several lines, give the first line of the faulty statement. If there is no bug, set the line to null.

fields.line: integer|null (1-based, required when has_bug is true)

evidence.title: A test that exposes the defect
evidence.body:
Test: assert is_sublist([2,4,3,5,7],[3,7])==False
Expected: False
Actual: True

recommendation.text: I found a bug on line 15.

annotations.notes: Adapted from MBPP task_id 69. Accepts a match after the first element instead of the whole sublist. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only.
